comments.comment: Love this @i.am.prolife !! Happy to answer any questions— send us a message or tag us in the comments 💛

As an adoptee and adoption advocate, I am not in love with this sign. This treats the child as a commodity. There are over 1 million couples waiting to adopt, that information can be shared without making adoption feel transactional.
Yes, and then a lovely couple who wants children desperately will be charged $50 to $60k to adopt the child officially.
